response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which has the highest applicable priority (90). RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False. Although the standard and electronics window rules (RET-008, RET-003) would render the item ineligible due to days_since_delivery (33) exceeding their limits, RET-020 dominates and allows return of defective items regardless of the standard window.
